acceptance_criteria: Rejection - including any declared library-bound, cross-reference, or ambiguity violation - returns diagnostics and no plan artifact of any kind; a resolved plan is emitted only when every declared bound and cross-reference is satisfied.
Compilation performs no filesystem mutation, no registry lookup, no socket or network use, and no process creation, and a late mutation of an already-hashed input is detected.
The same declared inputs compile to the same result independent of host environment details.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.

review_resolution.note: Successor correction: the predecessor emitted a resolved plan while a declared bound was exceeded; the amended criterion now makes any declared library-bound violation a rejection that yields no plan of any kind.

statement: The compiler shall be a pure offline function: a successful compile or a rejection shall start no component, perform no registry or filesystem discovery, open no network connection, mutate no external state, and return no partial or executable plan on rejection.
title: Pure offline no-side-effect compilation contract
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
